scope: Actual AuthStateService importer reader and SecretVault crypto over explicitly synthetic query rows; no real PG/lease/permission/effect/browser claims

tests.name: Historical ended capture is validated with actual encryption and HMAC before returning synthetic state
Fingerprint-only authority read decrypts zero material
Wrong current epoch rejects before decryption
Revoked state and unconsumed capture do not produce material
Historical tuple mismatch is rejected before decryption
Consistent tampering of database historical columns is still rejected by the encrypted envelope
Ciphertext tampering cannot yield imported state
Changed cookie value in a valid ciphertext is rejected by historical full-state HMAC
Encryption and HMAC historical key survive a real in-memory key-ring rotation
Replacing the historical key cannot validate the captured state
